liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (6 reviews): Bird Song is called fabulous; Bird Song is named as the other first-set highlight besides All Over Now [18][21][22][23][26][27]
- **Bertha** (2 reviews): Bertha rocks, Jerry gets every line right, and Hornsby plays great piano including a nice solo; The Stranger into Bertha opening is fantastic, with the band in high spirits and hitting hard [19][23]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (2 reviews): The Victim into Crazy Fingers pairing opening set two is judged unremarkable, and the Playin' outro decent but not great; Victim into Crazy was a staple pairing that year, somewhat boring, but well played here [21][22]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Stella Blue is described as wonderful, ending the segment after the drums and space jam; Reviewer wished the jam section of Stella Blue ran longer, though it is still nice [17][19]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Harmonies during Stranger are rough, and the band only finds its groove by All Over Now [21]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Jerry nails every lyric on Crazy Fingers, which the reviewer calls very rare [22]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Jerry sings a beautiful Terrapin leading into Drums, and Stella Blue closes out the jam [17]
- **Dark Star Jam** (1 review): The Dark Star jam is called wild [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-09-06.132965.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-09-06.147570.beyerCM101.ebel.flac2448**: source not stated; 18 songs; 171 min [7]
- **gd91-09-06.sbd.gardner.5560.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 163 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [8]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is called superb, recommended for fans of the 1991 sound [19]
- **gd1991-09-06.150286.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 164 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [10]
- **gd1991-09-06.150031.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 164 min [11]

## Around the show

- Crowd was a sing-along, with Cleveland fans described as fanatics, and a crowd recording captures that [25]
- Crowd went wild during Terrapin and Dark Star; Bruce and Vince added Brent-like vocal fills [25]
- Second set ran ten songs straight without a let-up [25]
- A "We Want Phil" chant started; Phil pointed at the crowd and the band launched into Tom Thumb's Blues [27]
- The band took a long time noodling before starting the opening Stranger [27]
- Reviewer judges this the best of the run from their seats, calling the first night energetic and the second smoother [17]
- This Richfield run was good throughout but is often overshadowed by the following week at MSG with Branford [23]
- Reviewer found the Victim, Crazy, Playin', Terrapin sequence stale from being played too often, and felt the band was coasting [24]
- Some fans saw it as a letdown after the previous two nights, with weaker song selection but strong playing [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-09-06.132965.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:095314) SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master; Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->… [1]. Also: This is a matrix recording by dusborne, with show information embedded in the FLAC file headers [1]
- **gd1991-09-06.147570.beyerCM101.ebel.flac2448**: transferred by Transfers by Pete Ebel January 30, 2018; source: TS Beyer CM 101-> Sony D6-> Cassette Master (Set #1:Maxell XL-II's 90's & Set #2:Maxell XL-II's 100's) [7]. Also: A Beyer CM101 source; a Sennheiser ME 80 recording covers tape flips and the deck pause before the encore [7]
- **gd91-09-06.sbd.gardner.5560.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd> dat> c> dat> cdr [8]
- **gd1991-09-06.150286.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  June 2, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [10]. Also: Front-of-board Schoeps CMC4/MK4 to DAT, recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy, with Dan O'Neill supplying patch source [10]
- **gd1991-09-06.150031.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  June 2, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [11]. Also: Front-of-board Schoeps CMC4/MK4 to DAT, recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy, with Dan O'Neill supplying patch source [11]

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1991-09-06 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1991-09-06-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [30]
- Poster by Michael: [1991-09-06 Richfield Coliseum, Richfield, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-09-06-richfield-coliseum-richfield-oh-usa/) [31]
